image.prompt:
Product photograph of one isolated object, shot from a HIGH THREE-QUARTER ANGLE: the camera is well above the object and tilted down about 30 degrees, so the top of the object is clearly visible along with its front and one side. Not a straight-on elevation.

The object: Standalone single-storey MK Restaurants suki hot pot outlet building, detailed front elevation with a wide glazed frontage showing booth tables under a green fascia carrying the MK roundel wordmark on an illuminated sign, a backlit photographic menu panel set flush beside the glass entrance door, plain warm cream painted side and rear walls in a single flat off-white tone clearly lighter than the background, with a kitchen service door and an extract grille, flat roof with a low parapet and roof-mounted air-conditioning condensers Materials: green painted composite panel and backlit printed menu face at the front, plate glass, flat warm cream painted render on side and rear walls, galvanised roof plant and extract ducting.

Form: build the object from a few simple, chunky, closed volumes. Prefer solid panels over lattice, mesh, grilles or perforated screens; keep any openings few, large and clearly separated. No thin spindly protrusions, no wires, no chains, no fringes, no lace, no fine filigree, no dense repeated slots or cut-outs. Keep the silhouette simple and readable from every side. Keep the object's SHAPE simple; richness must come from the surface finish, wear and materials rather than from intricate geometry. The object is still photoreal and highly detailed in its texture -- only its form is simple.

Framing: long-lens near-orthographic perspective, minimal foreshortening. The object is perfectly centred and occupies about 75% of the frame height, with clear empty margin on all four sides. The whole object is in frame; nothing is cropped.

Background: completely flat seamless MID-DARK neutral grey (#606060), distinctly darker than every part of the building so the object reads as a clean cut-out against it. The object floats in empty space against an infinite seamless backdrop with nothing underneath it. There is no surface for it to rest on and nothing for it to cast a shadow onto. No floor, no ground plane, no horizon line, no cast shadow, no contact shadow, no reflection, no vignette, no gradient.

Lighting: flat even studio illumination from all sides, soft and shadowless, like a lightbox. No strong key light, no rim light, no coloured light, no specular blowout, no dramatic highlights. Colours must read as true albedo.

One object only, nothing else in frame. No people, no hands, no other props, no packaging, no watermarks, no measurement annotations, no arrows, no borders, no drop shadow. Apart from the building's own signage described above, there is no other text or lettering anywhere in the frame.

Photoreal, sharp focus edge to edge, clean and undamaged geometry, realistic materials and surface wear. Not stylised, not cartoon, not low-poly, not a 3D render preview, not a wireframe.

license.notice: Real trademark: MK Restaurants. The repo's MIT licence covers this asset's code, not the mark; anyone shipping it needs their own trademark clearance.

review.critique: FINAL VERDICT. Overall visual fidelity 0.85 -- not a pass self-score. 864/16000 triangles, 10/12 draw calls, 7/8 materials, 10/16 unique geometries, 2 textures. The shopfront rebuild added a door leaf, a lightbox and a pull bar at ZERO extra draw calls: all folded into the existing glazing and frame components.

featureReviews.evidence: Envelope built at exactly 8.00 x 4.60 x 7.00 m against the declared 8 x 4.6 x 7.
featureReviews.notes: Two corrections got it there. The prop first built 6.3 m DEEP against a declared 7.0, because the shared template sets the shell face back to z=2.50 to leave room for an entrance canopy -- and this building has none; the shell face was pushed out to 3.22 instead. It also built 4.69 m tall with its green pilasters dipping to y=-0.09, below its own ground plane. Meshy reads the plate 10% taller and 17% deeper than the declared module; the declaration is the kit's shared retail module across seven siblings and wins.

featureReviews.evidence: Round white disc (#F9FAF9, PBR confidence 0.833) proud of the green band and left of centre, carrying red italic MK over a green RESTAURANTS band inside a green ring.
featureReviews.notes: Built as a CircleGeometry face plus a cylinder body after the first build put the mark on its SIDE: CylinderGeometry lays cap UVs out in its own XZ plane and rotating the geometry does not rotate them with it, so a rotated cylinder cap sampled the square canvas sideways. The body's UVs are collapsed onto a plain corner so the rim does not smear the mark around it. Glyphs are Arial, not MK's own script face.

featureReviews.evidence: Green panelling #396940 measured at standard deviation 3 (PBR confidence 0.803) as a band across the front with a full-height pilaster at BOTH front corners; walls elsewhere stay cream #E1D0B2.
featureReviews.notes: Band and both pilasters are one component and one draw call -- they share a material, so three components would have cost three submissions for one cladding system.

featureReviews.evidence: Near-black powder-coated frame #3A3023 (PBR confidence 0.734): one butt-glazed window, one door bay with transom and pull bar, and the lightbox border -- every black part in one component, read off the rectified plate (sign/glass.png).
featureReviews.notes: Rebuilt 2026-08-27 to the plate's layout. The first build carried a generic bay grid -- a floating transom and three mullions at arbitrary x -- and did not read as this storefront. The plate was rectified into the shopfront plane (250 px/m) and the layout read off it: one window to x=1.18, a single glass door bay 1.18..2.22 with a short transom and a pull bar, and a wall bay carrying a 0.80 x 2.08 m menu lightbox. The same rectified image is projected over the glazing by world position, so the interior and the menu poster come from the plate rather than a hand-drawn stand-in. The frame now sits 3 cm BEHIND the green band face, as the plate shows the storefront recessed. Metalness 0.25: the harness has no environment map.

featureReviews.evidence: Flush service door and a louvre vent panel on the +X wall, folded into one component.
featureReviews.notes: Deliberately NOT mirrored onto the -X wall, which the single plate does not show.
